title: Data Bias According to Bipol: Men are Naturally Right and It is the Role of Women to Follow Their Lead

bias_targets.methodology: Two-step 'bipol' metric: initial binary bias classification using trained multilingual models (mT5/mBERT), followed by a TF-IDF-style lexicon evaluation that calculates the absolute difference in frequencies of sensitive gender terms (e.g., male vs. female) in the biased samples.

Two-step 'bipol' metric: initial binary bias classification of text samples, followed by a lexicon-based evaluation that measures the disparity in frequencies of sensitive racial terms (e.g., Black vs. White) within the identified biased samples.

Two-step 'bipol' metric: initial binary bias classification of text samples, followed by a lexicon-based evaluation that measures the disparity in frequencies of sensitive religious terms (e.g., Christian, Muslim, Hindu) within the identified biased samples.
